sn28.3:1.3: vippasannāni kho te āvuso sārīputta indriyāni parisuddho mukhavaṇṇo pariyodāto
sn28.3:2.1: idhāhaṃ āvuso pītiyā ca virāgā upekkhako ca viharāmi sato ca sampajāno sukhañca kāyena paṭisaṃvedemi yantaṃ ariyā ācikkhanti upekkhako satimā sukhavihārīti tatiyaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharāmi.
sn28.3:2.2: tassa mayhaṃ āvuso na evaṃ hoti
sn28.3:2.3: ahaṃ tatiyaṃ jhānaṃ samāpajjāmīti vā ahaṃ tatiyaṃ jhānaṃ samāpannoti vā ahaṃ tatiyā jhānā vuṭṭhitoti vāti.
sn28.3:2.4: tathā hi panāyasmato sārīputtassa dīgharattaṃ ahaṅkāramamaṅkāramānānusayā susamūhatā
sn28.3:2.5: tasmā āyasmato sārīputtassa na evaṃ hoti
sn28.3:2.6: ahaṃ tatiyaṃ jhānaṃ samāpajjāmīti vā ahaṃ tatiyaṃ jhānaṃ samāpannoti vā ahaṃ tatiyā jhānā vuṭṭhitoti vāti.
